findings.claim: The plan does not say how `kmctl summary nudge` passes through the ADR 0026 hand-off, and the hand-off as written would hurt every tool call in a project whose pin differs from the copy on PATH. `hand_off` in src/kmctl/pin.py runs every verb except `briefing` through uvx online (`offline=False`), which builds the pinned copy when uv has not cached it. The PostToolUse hook fires on every Write, Edit, MultiEdit and Bash call, so in such a project each call would start uvx, and an uncached build can hit the 10 s hook timeout. Claude Code then kills the hook, so the build may never finish and the next call waits again. A user-scope install (settings_path supports the user's settings.json) also fires the hook in projects pinned to a release from before this ticket. That release has no `summary nudge` verb, so it prints a Typer usage error and exits 2. The shell guard keeps the exit at 0, but every call still pays the uvx cost. The plan's "exits 0 with {} on any failure" covers only the nudge's own code. It needs to say whether `summary nudge` gets the briefing's treatment (offline probe, quiet or run locally when the pin is not cached) or skips the hand-off, and r2 needs a quiet case for a project pinned to another release.
